name: Accountable
what: Bookkeeping, invoicing and tax app for self-employed people in Germany and Belgium.

membership.basis: On the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026). No round announcement found that names Visionaries.

status.event: Acquired by Visma (Hg-owned); valuation reported in the high double-digit millions

notes: Entry undetermined: the Series A (EUR 6M, Stride.VC lead with existing investor Connect Ventures; startbase 2021-09-15) and its May 2022 extension to EUR 10M total (10x Founders, Billie founders, George Pallis; eu-startups 2022-05-05, read via the Wayback copy) do not name Visionaries; WebSearch and Google News found no Visionaries round. Accountable is absent from the 2023-2025 WordPress portfolio captures and appears only on the 2026 live list. Exit: Handelsblatt 2025-04-25, 'Der Softwarekonzern Visma kauft Accountable', valuation 'im hohen zweistelligen Millionenbereich' (no figure, so no valuation recorded). HQ: the company says it serves Germany 'out of our Berlin headquarters' (about-us page); the legal entity is Accountable SA, Saint-Josse-ten-Noode (Brussels), Belgium (imprint, VAT BE0682763303); founding year not cited (vendor profiles say 2017, Belgium; eu-startups says it has operated in Germany 'since 2020'). Series A extension amount 4M is derived (10M total minus 6M). Focus: fintech (tax/accounting for freelancers); SaaS would also fit.
